Customer Order Form

1. Parties

This customer order form (the "Order Form") is made between ExampleCorp Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales with its registered office at 14 Cobbled Yard, Chester CH1 2HH ("Supplier"), and Example Corp, a company registered in England and Wales with its registered office at 22 Heronfield Business Park, Reading RG7 4PL ("Customer"). Supplier and Customer are each a "party" and together the "parties". This Order Form incorporates by reference the Supplier's standard subscription terms (the "Master Terms").

2. Order details

Customer purchases a subscription to the Supplier's Halyard Analytics platform for forty (40) named users, together with onboarding assistance and standard support, as further described in Schedule 1 to this Order Form. The initial term commences on 1 October 2026 (the "Effective Date").

3. Fees

Customer shall pay an annual subscription fee of GBP 18,000, plus one-off onboarding fees of GBP 2,500, together with applicable VAT. Subscription fees are invoiced annually in advance, and onboarding fees are invoiced on the Effective Date. Fees are non-refundable except as expressly stated in the Master Terms.

4. Payment terms

Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within ninety (90) days of the invoice date. If any undisputed amount remains unpaid after the due date, Supplier may charge interest at the statutory rate and may suspend access to the services until payment is received in full. Customer may withhold only amounts disputed in good faith and notified in writing before the due date.

5. Term and renewal

This Order Form takes effect on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of three (3) years. Thereafter, the subscription automatically renews for successive three (3) year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Supplier may adjust renewal pricing by written notice given at least ninety (90) days before renewal, provided any increase does not exceed eight percent of the fees for the preceding term.

6. Liability

Each party's aggregate liability under this Order Form is capped at the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit, or loss of goodwill. Nothing in this Order Form limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

7. Termination

Either party may terminate this Order Form for a material breach that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice of the breach. Either party may also terminate immediately if the other party becomes insolvent or enters into administration, liquidation, or an analogous proceeding. Termination does not affect rights or obligations accrued before the termination date.

8. Governing law

This Order Form is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.

9. General

This Order Form, together with the Master Terms it references, forms the entire agreement between the parties for the services described in it and supersedes all prior discussions. It may only be amended in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign this Order Form without the other party's written consent, except to an affiliate or in connection with a merger or sale of substantially all its assets.

10. Signatures

Signed by the duly authorised representatives of the parties.
